# 1.2.123 - the auditor's check of 1.2.122, and the owner's three: the curtain keeps its glass, Move left and right in the planner, and the planner's camera follows the node you change

One stage ships: E123 (tools/stages.json). It carries every finding of the auditor's check of 1.2.122
(audit/findings-1.2.118/recheck-122.json, lanes A to H and HB), the regressions it found in 1.2.122, the items of the
auditor's probe 43 that were left, and three requests of the owner of 21.11.2026, in one update (the owner's decision:
"Wszystko w 1.2.123"). Built by thirteen lines: ITEMS, STG, TEXT, MURDER, MAP, UI, WORLD, R1 (branch refresh-120),
TRIAL, INVEST, CORE, DESP and COMM, and the assembly's own commits. **E39, E40, E43, E53, E58 and E83 are not
shipped**, planned 1.2.124. E26 stays 1.3.0. From v1.2.122 (the tag) to b4b3518c, the assembly's last commit before
this release commit: 73 commits, 23 of them merges of the lines into the assembly (`git rev-list --count` and
`--merges --count`).

In plain words. Everything below is read off the code and the headless harness; none of it has run on a real Foundry or
at a table (## Checked).

**The owner's three** (21.11.2026).
- The curtain's panes keep their colour and texture when the curtain moves: folding Projects, a phase change, a tile
  shown or hidden. Before, a pane's look was drawn from a hash of its centre, so a pane that moved drew a new tint and
  stain, and some went from stained to plain or back, until the next recut; the art layers were not the cause. A pane
  of the new cut that shares at least half of its area, and half of the old pane's, with a pane of the old cut now
  takes that pane's look (glass.mjs `carryPaneLook`, `paneLooks`; OWNER-123-CURTAIN; R8630). Where a streak sits
  inside a pane can still change (## Known gaps).
- The planner's nodes have **Move left** and **Move right**: a deduction or a counter moves a column right with what
  rests on it, and back. Evidence keeps the first column and the solution the last; their buttons are shut and say why,
  as is Move left on a node already in its leftmost column (case-layout.mjs `layoutCase`'s `shift`, `shiftOf`;
  case-schema.mjs; case-map.mjs; investigation.mjs `shiftCaseNode`; OWNER-123-PLAN-1; R8570).
- After your own Move or sort, and while you type in a node that grows, the planner's camera centres on that node: it
  keeps its zoom while the node fits the view and zooms out to fit one that does not. Another GM's change no longer
  pulls your view (case-view.mjs `centreCamera`; investigation.mjs `ownChange`, `OWN_CHANGE_MS` 1500 ms;
  OWNER-123-PLAN-2; R8571).

**Regressions of 1.2.122, fixed** (the auditor's check of 1.2.122).
- A student who finds another's hidden stash sees it on their sheet and can Rifle it again (hidden-stashes.mjs
  `foundRowsFor`, `readersOf`; r122-ITEMS-R-3).
- The timed room action of a completed secret project ends for its insiders as it does for the GM, and saving the
  action in the editor no longer restarts its lifetime (projects.mjs `tellSight`, `receiveSight`; facilities.mjs
  `setProjectFacility`; r122-ITEMS-R-1, R-2).
- In an open murder, a third party whose Escape Together fails sees the full number on their result card again, the one
  their menu showed. Behind a mask or in a trap the defence stays hidden (r122-C-R1).
- Configure Ownership and Daggerheart's character settings no longer redraw themselves, and lose what a GM was setting,
  every time a token moves or an item changes; the room watch redraws only a character's own sheet
  (sheet-inventory.mjs `redrawRoomSheets`; r122-E-R1; R8438).
- The GM's Remnant card keeps the words being typed in its two text boxes when it redraws (a token moving, a trace
  found), and saves them once when the GM leaves the box (live.mjs `childIndex`, `findKeyed`; r121-R-1, r122-H-R1;
  R8545).

**What a player's browser no longer learns**.
- A masked killer's name that holds &, ' or " is shown as "?" to readers outside the mask; before, cards that wrote it
  escaped printed it in clear (secret.mjs `maskNames`, `wordsFor`; r122-C-1; R8118).
- When the primary GM puts a token back from a bedroom its player has not found, the bedroom's name is no longer sent to
  that player's browser (movement-audit.mjs `markOf`, `roomsFoundBy`; r122-E-4, E-6; R8352).
- A Monocub's or Spectator's map no longer shows rooms a Spectator's token was once seeded into while standing there
  (gm-stores.mjs `ghostSeed`; MAP-19's rest; R8353).
- A GM's Listen run for a student no longer names a killer veiled for the opening (action-listen.mjs `heardIn`;
  r122-F-1).
- Contraband's notice to the owner of the destroyed item no longer names the owner to other browsers (call-effects.mjs;
  r122-G).
- A Spectator's safeword card is drawn in the card's own words on every browser, and the primary GM writes the card's
  words over any other words it was posted with (spectator-ui.mjs `drawOwnCard`, `ownCardWords`; r122-E-2; R8439).

**Windows that follow the table while they stand open** (the owner's rule "Zawsze odswiezamy okna od razu przy
zmianie"; probe 43; the lanes D, F, G and H).
- The action windows' briefing, Analyze's bullets and Tamper's list of whom to frame follow the table while the window
  is open; "You have N" in Details changes and the picked row stays (action-briefing.mjs `briefingBlock`;
  action-menus.mjs `keepBriefing`, `wireLiveBriefings`; action-analyze.mjs; action-tamper.mjs; p43-1).
- The open crisis menu also follows what a row unfolds: Breakdown's disadvantage appears as soon as a victim's Sanity
  runs out. When the fight ends, an open crisis menu closes saying the fight is over, instead of saying the turn will
  come back (action-menus.mjs `keepRowsLive`; action-murder.mjs; `DRPG.Murder.fightOver`; r122-C-2, C-4).
- The GM's Murder window updates its Killer and Victim lists as soon as a student dies or is brought back
  (murder-ui.mjs `seatsHtml`; p43-2).
- Despair Flow follows another GM's changes while it is open, keeping what you typed (gm-team-dialog.mjs).
- End the chapter shows and removes its warnings (a Truth Bullet with no type, the Final Truth not placed) while it
  stays open (chapter.mjs `refreshChapterEnd`; REFR-40).
- Season setup's scenes part draws a student created or deleted while it stands, and its hooks go when its window closes
  (trial-scene.mjs `followRoles`; r122-C-5).
- A node pressed in the trial console's schema opens on the Investigation window that already stands, on the Map or
  from the Table; until 1.2.123 the window was only raised (investigation.mjs `caseHandOff`; r122-C-3).
- Changing the Order or Chapter filter on the Investigation window's Table no longer empties the Final Truth form or
  unticks the Key limit's override.
- Item tables no longer writes a half-typed entry name or description when another table changes, and is not redrawn
  for a change to another table. Create an item on a second card fills the open item tables with that card's details,
  unless the GM has typed in the New item tab (tables-editor.mjs).
- Room setup's Passages tab no longer closes an open '+' menu when a player spends an action (passages-tab.mjs; R8546).
  Room setup shows an unset start lock as it will be kept, and Apply no longer writes a room the GM did not touch
  (room-setup.mjs).
- An open character sheet is no longer redrawn by a change in its room while its player is typing in it; it redraws
  once the player leaves the field (sheet-inventory.mjs `typingIn`, `renderWhenLeft`; r122-H-6; R8547).
- The Autopsy window's student boxes no longer redraw on every roll, so a tick takes the first time (gm-items.mjs;
  r122-H-5).
- The handover picker no longer moves the choice to someone else when the person picked leaves the room; it says who
  left, and OK waits for a new pick (handover.mjs; `DRPG.Handover.pickedLeft`).
- The Debug log offers Copy and Clear as soon as it holds an entry, and hides them when it is empty (gm-panel.mjs;
  r122-H-8).
- A new Mastermind's player sees every hidden stash at once, and a former Mastermind's player stops seeing them, without
  a reload (hidden-stashes.mjs; r122-F-8). Rifle says when the thing you picked was taken a moment before, instead of
  closing on nothing (stash-reach.mjs; `DRPG.Vault.rifleGone`; r122-E-5). The project window's "Which project" list for
  a trap follows projects created or deleted while it is open (projects-ui.mjs).
- A Call's project picker drops a project finished while it is open (call-pickers.mjs).
- A player's token settings window is closed each time it is drawn, not only the first time (token-hud.mjs; r122-E-1,
  finishing r120-H-3).
- The settings window no longer keeps listening for microphones after it closes (voice-panel.mjs; R8591).

**Two GMs**.
- A second GM's change of a room's Search Tokens in Room setup is added to the count the primary GM holds, so it no
  longer undoes a Search spent a moment before; a Search a second GM throws for a character they play is spent by the
  primary GM too (search-tokens.mjs `stepFor`, `stepForHere`; r122-lane-B-7, MAP-40).
- A find left waiting on the window of a GM who leaves is finished by the remaining primary GM; the Observe find's
  description window no longer closes under a GM who is still typing, and at its time it sends what was typed
  (observe.mjs; CASE-37's rest, r122-D-2).
- When a second GM's Play cannot play, that GM is told why; the primary GM sees nothing (music-play.mjs `playTrack`).
- A breach's lifted seal no longer comes back when a Seal is written at the same moment (call-world.mjs
  `inCallWorldQueue`).

**Rules, cards and prices**.
- A player back from an absence is shown the newest eight of their returned private cards, not the oldest
  (r122-lane-B-1; scenario 73 R4).
- A player back at the table while their opening roll is owed gets the invitation again, but no second "your opening
  roll" card, and is not invited while the primary GM's own window is throwing that roll for them (murder-rules.mjs
  `openingThrownHere`; bridge-runs-acts.mjs; incident-store.mjs `keepOpeningNotice`; r122-lane-B-2, B-3).
- An opening-roll invitation that arrives before the player's copy of the cast waits for it, and tells the GMs if it
  never comes (murder-rules.mjs `copyOnItsWay`; r122-D-3).
- A co-owner's Observe of an empty room is ruled in that player's thread (r122-D-4). "Send another ballot (n)" counts
  only the players a reminder reaches (vote.mjs; trial-floor-ui.mjs).
- Tail Someone gives the action back after a target walks out only when its rolls brought no Hope, and its Roll says
  when the student picked has left the room (action-tail.mjs `rollsEarnedHope`; r122-F-2; R8580). A Reroll ends only the card of the ruling it replaced
  (reroll.mjs).
- A Monocub's Give and Not now act only on a card about the card writer's own Monocub (R8590). Unblock on a player whose
  role withholds the microphone tells the GM why, and changes nothing (voice-tile.mjs; R8592).

**Texts and the handbooks** (line TEXT).
- In Polish, the roll window's Pass button reads "Pas". Room setup's Stashes note says in English, as in Polish, that
  the Mastermind sees every hidden stash.
- The handbooks say what the code does in six places (r122-HB-1 to HB-6; R8620): the player handbook's voice table has
  the **Hidden** state; the camera dock takes a masked killer's tile off with the voice tile off; the Debug log's
  buttons follow its rows; the loot button's place with anonymous sheets off; section 22's lists name what 1.2.122 moved
  to the GMs; a finished Repair the Lock project unticks the broken lock.

**Corrections to the notes of 1.2.122** (the auditor's r122-A-1, A-2).
- The 1.2.122 notes said that no part of the local gate had run on that release's tree. The shipped gate record
  (fcbb2753) has one part passed, press-live-region, eight parts not run, verdict incomplete.
- The 1.2.122 notes said tables-editor.mjs went under the 1500-line bound. It did not: it stands at 1675 lines, on the
  accepted list (tools/check.mjs `LENGTHS_ACCEPTED`), under the 1750 ceiling.

- **No setting is registered** (`game.settings.register` on 204 lines of scripts/ at v1.2.122 and here). No GM store is
  added.
- **Language**: lang/en.json goes from 6508 to 6521 keys: 13 added (Move left and right with its four tooltips, and
  `DRPG.Cleanup.trailGone`, `DRPG.Murder.fightOver`, `DRPG.Vault.rifleGone`, `DRPG.Handover.pickedLeft`,
  `DRPG.Observe.describeTimedOutTyped`, `DRPG.Infiltrate.tail.goneKept`, `DRPG.Voice.list.gmRoleBlocks`), none removed,
  1 changed (`DRPG.Vault.stashesNote`). lang/pl.json goes from 7597 to 7610: the same 13 added, none removed, 1 changed
  (`DRPG.TraitRuling.pass`). Counted on the flattened files, v1.2.122 against b4b3518c.
- No glyph added (icons/ and tools/glyphs.json have no change). No console name changed (tools/api-surface.json has no
  change in the range).
- **Daggerheart**: `verified` stays 2.12.9. **Foundry**: module.json's compatibility has no change (minimum 14.364,
  verified 14.365); the owner's sandbox runs 14.370, which module.json does not name.

## Known gaps

- **Not shipped**: E39, E40, E43, E53, E58 and E83 (tools/stages.json, planned 1.2.124). E26 stays 1.3.0.
- The curtain: where a streak sits inside a moved pane can still change, and the band's paint (`paintBand`) is not
  carried (OWNER-123-CURTAIN; LIVE-U123-03 allows it).
- A GM's item update judged after the comparison at ready has deleted that item still takes it back into the GMs'
  sheet mark (sheet-audit.mjs `itemMoves`); carried from 1.2.122, not fixed.
- The opening roll's re-invitation (r122-lane-B-2, partly): a window a second GM throws is that GM's page state and is
  not seen from the primary, so it does not hold the invitation back; and the other window is not closed when the first
  result lands. CORE-41 stays as it is, by design: a player's
  own ask carries `gmAsk` on the ordinary road of every call on the GM.
- The Monocub's Hope ask (monocub.mjs `answerHopeAsk`) does not read `askOpen` (r122-G-3's rest).
- Mutants that survived: one on Listen's side (r122-F-1) and one on the trial's cleared hand-off (r122-C-3).
- **The local gate**: only its press part ran (## Checked); its eight parts that need a Foundry v14 sandbox did not, so
  its verdict is incomplete. Nothing in this release has run on a real Foundry or at a table.
- **Carried, not closed**: the 13 rows of audit/harness/known-leaks.json, as at 1.2.122.
